phase: 4b (graphics consumed in place per emitted draw; CORE_REALTIME_COPIES M4)
change: OriginalApplicationLoadedMenuSession.Attempt.emit and OriginalApplicationMenuSession.step's emit called consume on a copy of the graphics owner and stored it back; they now call it on the owner in place. consume is all-or-nothing (window, bitmap and front each work on their own copy and assign it on success; the bitmap case's missing-inputs throw comes first), so a throw leaves the owner as the copy did. bitmapInputs is bound before the in-place access (passing it inline would overlap the class property's modify access).

phone.result: 16.01 / 16.06 ticks/s: no measurable change. Committed as strictly less work without added complexity (one owner copy, about 14-21 reference-count operations, fewer per draw; the code is no longer).

review: independent read-only review: OK. consume is all-or-nothing at every throw point (all mutations land on next); the attempt's state and the step's local have no observers and consume runs no callbacks, so nothing re-enters during the in-place access; a graphicsObserve throw leaves the same state as before (the owner was assigned before observing in both versions); binding bitmapInputs first is equivalent and needed.
